target.title: fix: honor configured default agent across main paths
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the remaining hardcoded `DEFAULT_AGENT_ID = "main"` assumptions called out in #90573 for deployments whose configured default agent is not `main`.

PR #30654 fixed the main session-key write paths, but #90573 identified follow-on paths that still synthesized `agents/main/*`, `agent:main:*`, or phantom `main` audit scopes even when config declares a different default agent such as `nova`.

This PR uses the existing `agents.list[].default` / first-agent behavior. It intentionally does **not** add a new `agents.defaultAgentId` config key or `OPENCLAW_DEFAULT_AGENT_ID` environment variable.

## Why This Change Was Made

The current behavior makes non-`main` default-agent deployments inconsistent: some surfaces honor the configured default agent, while others silently route storage, session keys, setup directories, or audit reporting through `main`. That creates broken paths and confusing phantom state for multi-agent installs.

## User Impact

Deployments whose configured default agent is not `main` can keep using their chosen default agent without residual `main` paths leaking into session initialization, auth/model storage scans, setup transcript directories, or exec-scope audit output.

## Changes

- Key new explicit `sessionId` sessions to the resolved store/default agent instead of literal `main`.
- Thread the resolved agent id into auto-reply session initialization.
- Resolve default auth/model storage scan paths from the configured default agent directory.
- Stop security audit exec-scope reporting from injecting a phantom `main` default when another agent is configured as default.
- Avoid inferring a delivery channel from one-segment agent main-session keys when the agent id happens to match a channel name.
- Let setup create the configured default agent's transcript directory instead of `agents/main/sessions` when config is available.

## Risk Mitigations

- **Compatibility:** no schema/env surface added; legacy `main` aliases are still recognized where they already were.
- **Auth-provider:** storage discovery still includes existing directories under state plus configured agent dirs; this only replaces the synthetic default path.
- **Session-state:** new explicit sessions use the same effective default agent that owns the selected store; existing persisted keys are not migrated here.

## Evidence

Current head: `2461ca921f5665e8ac8e91c540ba567342ba64ee`.

- Focused default-agent proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/secrets/storage-scan.default-agent.test.ts src/agents/command/session.resolve-session-key.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session-delivery.test.ts src/config/sessions/paths.default-agent.test.ts src/security/audit-exec-surface.test.ts` — passed 4 Vitest shards / 41 tests.
- Typecheck: `pnpm tsgo:core` — passed.
- Formatting: `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/agents/command/session.resolve-session-key.test.ts src/agents/command/session.ts src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply-fast-path.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session-delivery.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session-delivery.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session.ts src/commands/setup.ts src/config/sessions/paths.ts src/config/sessions/paths.default-agent.test.ts src/secrets/auth-store-paths.ts src/secrets/storage-scan.ts src/secrets/storage-scan.default-agent.test.ts src/security/audit-exec-surface.test.ts src/security/audit.ts` — passed.
- Touched-file lint: `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/agents/command/session.resolve-session-key.test.ts src/agents/command/session.ts src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply-fast-path.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session-delivery.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session-delivery.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session.ts src/commands/setup.ts src/config/sessions/paths.ts src/config/sessions/paths.default-agent.test.ts src/secrets/auth-store-paths.ts src/secrets/storage-scan.ts src/secrets/storage-scan.default-agent.test.ts src/security/audit-exec-surface.test.ts src/security/audit.ts` — passed.
- Whitespace: `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — passed.
- GitHub check rollup for current head includes passing CI, CodeQL/security, OpenGrep, dependency/security-sensitive guards, and Real behavior proof checks.

Closes #90573.
Supersedes stale #17477 without adding the previously proposed config/env fallback surface.
